records.claim: Damage to the inner lining of the eye (called retinopathy) is an uncommon side effect of taking hydroxychloroquine. This has raised a theoretical (not proven) concern that taking hydroxychloroquine in pregnancy could cause vision problems in the offspring. However, most studies on young children born to women who took hydroxychloroquine in pregnancy have not found an increase in eye problems.
records.source_section: Does taking hydroxychloroquine increase the chance of other pregnancy-related problems?
